description: Starter catalogue for parity-interaction-engine (parity-contracts 0.13.0). Copy it to the service's repository as logging/events.parity-interaction-engine.v1.json; the service owns it from then on.

interaction.created.description: A call became an interaction: IE owns it from here (attrs.origin: pstn, agent, api, callback; parent_xsid when another call caused it).

interaction.state_changed.description: The interaction's state machine moved (new, ivr, queued, offered, connected, consulting, wrap_up, ended).

interaction.adopted.description: This replica took over a call whose owner died (owner_epoch is the new one).

interaction.ended.description: The customer's call ended (attrs.end_reason: completed, abandoned, failed, busy, no_answer).

leg.added.description: A leg joined the call (attrs.role: customer, agent, consult, supervisor).

ivr.input_collected.description: The IVR collected input: attrs.presses counts keys. Digits never appear.

routing.enqueued.description: Enqueue to the routing engine answered.

routing.assigned.description: The routing engine assigned an agent (Watch: Assigned).

routing.rpc_failed.description: A routing RPC failed; outcome retry while attempts remain.

command.refused.description: An interaction.commands command was answered with an error code.

consult.started.description: An agent started a consult: a child call with its own xsid, parent_xsid the customer's call.

consult.completed.description: The consult completed (warm transfer): the consulted agent's leg joins the parent call, which keeps its xsid.

cdr.written.description: The CDR row for the interaction was written (insert-only, idempotent).

owner.lease_lost.description: No etcd keepalive worked for a whole TTL: new calls are declined.
